reviews.author: Regina

reviews.title: When they say "Be Quiet!", they mean it.
reviews.comment: I bought the 1200 watt version a couple years ago to support a gaming rig which was going to have a RTX 4090 whenever I could get my hands on one. This power supply makes *no* noise. At idle, the fans don't run at all. While playing games, the run so quietly that the only way you know it is working is because you are playing a game. Using this supply and very quiet Artic water CPU coolers, I cannot hear my computer from 7 feet away. Even up close, my air purifier on its lowest setting makes more noise. The electrical filtering is excellent. My computer runs for 12-15 hours a day every day with no issues. I have 5 of these power supplies, and it is the only brand I buy now. They are only a little more expensive than my second favorite brand, Corsair, and the build quality, reliability, and super low noise make them worth every penny.
reviews.author: Morris L.

reviews.title: Really quiet PSU
reviews.comment: This is not powerful of course. But it is definitely the quitest on the market. No coil whine (like fan-less models) and fan does not ever spin (or I simply do not hear it). Seriously, I compared it to way more expensive models from seasonic. This is great. But, higher wattage models (more than 750) do have different fan management, so, check before you buy. If you do not have GPU (like in my case) or your GPU is not power hungry, this is the best choice if you are looking for silent PSU.
reviews.author: Alexey

reviews.title: Very good PSU without 8+4 pin CPU support
reviews.comment: Seems to be very high quality and is extremely quiet. Hoping this unit will last a long time. Deducted a star because it doesn't support CPU power of 8+4 which is apparently really common on Intel lga 1851 motherboards. I was forced to use on the 8 pin connection and leave the 4 pin unpowered for the CPU.
